title: Implement Gallery section variants (gallery-grid, gallery-masonry)
description: Implement two Gallery section variants. gallery-grid shows images in a uniform grid. gallery-masonry uses a CSS masonry-like layout for varied image heights.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: GalleryContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render all images with alt text
Images use next/image for optimization (or standard img with explicit dimensions)
Caption shown on image hover if present
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Uniform grid `grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`. Each image: aspect-square, object-cover. Hover overlay showing caption (if present). Max 12 images displayed.
Use CSS columns: `columns-2 md:columns-3`. Images: `break-inside-avoid mb-4 w-full`. This creates a Pinterest-style masonry layout without JavaScript. Alt text on each image.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify images load, layout is correct, captions appear on hover.
